## Escalation Level (EL)

L1/L2/L3/exec with rank, target role and `ackTargetMinutes` — an unacknowledged escalation is invisible risk, so the ack clock is first-class. `LEVEL_HUES` is exported beside the enum so every consumer colors the ladder alike.

### Non-goals

Not the escalation record itself (the Escalation card owns the event); not a rotation schedule (Role.onDuty is hand-set — no platform scheduler).
